question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/881bdb43a09c4b631ec1bc41d5f5fe59a2a77f64a550c3d4ba9e938a31ac63a6.png]
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0db2d37e3c5178f02e05e1f36443d0e2b6b47cd338ccd2ae6943cec932c7d8d1.png]
